dataset_version: Sugar4D V4, existing local release only
decision_priority: If current PointNet height or width exceeds 1cm and is >=1.5x a label-free geometry estimate on official validation, REPRESENTATION-FIRST. Otherwise ORGAN-TEMPORAL-JEPA only if the locked primary organ-history rule passes both controls; else PIVOT.
noise_scope: Predict published automatic morphology, not noise-free biological growth. Manual destructive comparisons are not longitudinal measurement-noise estimates. Area has no manual reference; cannot independently justify continuation.
selection: Train-only preprocessing; fixed architecture/budget; validation plant-macro standardized MAE, with visibility BCE for joint organ heads; event validation balanced BCE plus normalized count MAE. No test-based task or architecture selection.
input_contract: No future cloud, phenotype, instance ID, observation status, first-observation time or lifetime in forward inputs. Scheduled target DAS is a known query. Current/previous GT organ morphology is Oracle. C5 uses XYZ-only whole-plant descriptors.
missing_morphology: NaN in trajectories; excluded from morphology loss, never treated as real zero. Future visibility is separately scored for every eligible history window.
new_leaf_event: Count identities first observed at any actual scan after history end and through requested target scan; not botanical birth time. Future IDs used only to form labels.
